description: This is a localization file defining French translations for various UI components and texts in a chat application. It includes functions for dynamic content such as message counts and version info.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Generates a hint string for the input box, indicating the submit key and optional newline instruction, as well as a search prompt.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the current version of the application.

methods.name: IsLatest
methods.description: A string indicating whether the current version is the latest.

methods.name: CheckUpdate
methods.description: String guiding the user to check for updates.

methods.name: GoToUpdate
methods.description: Guides the user to the update process.

methods.name: Title
methods.description: Displays the title for various sections, like 'Prompt mémoire' or 'Paramètres'.
